query: Which validated scales (exact names, item counts, and language/back‑translation plans) will we use for wellbeing, belonging, and affect, and what are minimally important differences?

response.query: Which validated scales (exact names, item counts, and language/back‑translation plans) will we use for wellbeing, belonging, and affect, and what are minimally important differences?
response.answer: For wellbeing, use the WHO-5; for belonging, use the Social Connectedness Scale-12; for affect, use the Positive and Negative Affect Schedule (PANAS). Minimally important differences are typically 5-10 points on these scales.

Section 101(b) of the Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act of 2015 (MACRA) sunset the Medicare EHR Incentive Program for Eligible Professionals, set forth at section 1848(o) of the Act. results.title: EDITORIAL: What I Said When My White Friend Asked for ...
results.content: 4)Some of what I share covers sexism, too – intersectionality is another term I’m sure you’ve heard and want to put quotes around, but it’s a real thing, too, just like white privilege. If it’s unclear in any way, the point here is **if you’ve NEVER had a defining moment in your childhood or your life, where you realize your skin color alone makes other people hate you, you have white privilege**. The point here is, **if you’ve never been blindsided when you are just trying to enjoy a meal by a well-paid faculty member’s patronizing and racist assumptions about how grateful black people must feel to be in their presence – you have white privilege**. The point here is **– not having to rewrite stories, headlines or swap photos while being trolled by racists when all you’re trying to do on a daily basis is promote positivity and share stories of hope and achievement and justice – that is white privilege.**.
